name: US–China / Taiwan
value: 10 PLA aircraft, 8 ships in day to 14 Nov
summary: Taiwan counted 10 PLA aircraft and 8 warships in 24h to 14 Nov; Trump, Xi and Putin due to meet in Shenzhen on 19 Nov
state: Taiwan's defence ministry counted 10 Chinese military aircraft, eight naval vessels and three official ships around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 14 Nov, with 184 aircraft and 141 ships so far in November (Taiwan News). It had reported 30 aircraft in the day to 13 Nov, and a Taiwanese official said China rehearsed attacks on its cities in early November (Kyiv Post). China confirmed a Trump–Xi–Putin meeting in Shenzhen on 19 Nov. No blockade or clash was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Tension around Taiwan matters for electronics supply chains and shipping in East Asia; check FCDO travel advice before travel to the region.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA activity and drills around Taiwan = Watch

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
